title: Reconstructing inflationary features on large scales using genetic algorithm
summary: [Abridged] A variety of model-dependent as well as model-independent approaches suggest that certain localized features in the primordial scalar power spectrum can lead to a significantly better fit to the observed anisotropies in the cosmic microwave background (CMB). In this work, we focus on three types of such features and examine whether these features can be generated in inflationary scenarios driven by a single, canonical scalar field.
